_doc: Unmanaged-unit allowlist for tests/timer-manifest.test.sh (fleet-ops#4400). Lists user timers that are DELIBERATELY unmanaged: hand-placed units with no repo .timer source, one-shot investigation timers, or transient units created by a hand-run systemd-run. A live timer in this list no longer reddens the fleet check. Every entry requires a DATED reason: the reason field must start with YYYY-MM-DD, the date it was added or last reviewed. A unit may NOT be allowlisted if it has a repo-sourced .timer file (systemd/*.timer): repo-owned timers must have a MANIFEST entry and still hard-fail when missing. Adding or removing an entry goes through a normal PR with review (this file is config, not machinery). Deletion pinned (fleet-ops#4400): the fleet-ops-4219-dualrun-collect.timer/.service were transient leftovers from the #4219 P3a dual-run (PR #4371 merged) and were deleted on 2026-09-08; do not re-create, the phase is closed.

unmanaged.reason: 2026-09-10 transient one-shot (created by hand-run systemd-run) for the fleet-ops#4891 memory-budget re-measure. Fires once at 2026-09-11 14:05 UTC then self-releases (RemainAfterElapse=no). Deliberately not repo-sourced: its ExecStart packet lives in agent-state (outside the repo) and the unit carries no [Install]/Persistent, so a repo copy could not restart it on a rebuild anyway. fleet-ops#4952.
